0022600091.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Rockets host the Mavericks, and Houston will be without Steven Adams, who is day-to-day with rest and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and their most recent meeting was a 111-107 Rockets win in Houston on January 31, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives Houston a 70% chance to win.
